intent: Review the homepage camera pricing chooser for mobile clarity, truthful claims, and regressions; do not modify files.

visual_evidence.scope_reason: The task replaces a duplicated mobile selector with one physical camera choice surface.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: La acción principal debe ser obvia, cómoda para el pulgar y decir lo que pasa al tocar. Si cuesta descubrir dónde empezar, la mecánica no está terminada.
visual_evidence.comparison: Compare current duplicated lens-plus-chip control against one tactile selector with price and action visible together.

references.borrow: Keep the price and next action legible in the first reading path.
references.avoid: Do not retain the duplicated or tiny choice mechanism.

brief.visitor: A South Florida business owner, property professional, or creator deciding whether they need editing, filming, or property content.
brief.promise: Choose the kind of help needed and see the applicable starting price before contacting Esteban.
brief.primary_action: See the selected package and request a scoped quote.
brief.friction: The existing tiny lens is an undiscoverable duplicate control, while price and choice are split across separate widgets.

kpi.outcome: Qualified quote intent after a clear service selection.
kpi.baseline: Gap: no comparable chooser completion cohort has been read; record this as the pre-release measurement gap and compare production selection-to-quote intent after traffic accrues.
kpi.evidence: No current comparable chooser completion cohort was read in this task.
kpi.readout: Compare selection and quote-intent events after production traffic accrues.
kpi.decision_rule: Keep only if the selector remains understandable and does not reduce the visible-price path.

concept.brand_reason: Esteban’s work is made through filming and editing, so a physical focus dial gives service selection an appropriate visual metaphor.
concept.interaction: Tap one of three named stops on the camera dial.
concept.visible_response: The aperture/focus marker moves and the selected job, price, and package card update together.
concept.direct_path: The initial selected state exposes a starting price and package action without interaction.
concept.alternatives: A quiet single-project link retains the a-la-carte path without adding a fourth competing mode.

story.opening: A compact warm camera front shows the selected job.
story.action: The visitor selects a named focus stop.
story.consequence: The active offer and starting price change in the same visual field.
story.next_step: The visitor opens package scope or starts a scoped quote.

content.visible: Selected job, canonical starting price, one sentence, and one package action.
content.optional_html: Existing native details for deliverables and terms remain server rendered.
content.linked_depth: Existing package pages and the pricing hub.

references.borrow: Tactile cause-and-effect and the direct visible-price behavior.
references.avoid: Tiny unlabeled lens controls, faux camera telemetry, generic neon dashboards, and unverified equipment claims.

components.reuse: Existing HomeProjectPath, lane pricing helpers, native details, funnel, and current package data.
components.local_reason: The camera shell is brand-specific art direction around the established chooser behavior.

verification.rendered_states: 375x667, 390x844, and desktop; first and each selected stop.
verification.motion: Selected stop, reduced motion, keyboard, and touch.
verification.accessibility_performance: Semantic buttons, visible selected state, no overflow, no selector duplication.
verification.raw_html: All three canonical starting-price paths remain in server HTML.
verification.conversion_boundary: Existing package/quote action opens the current authorized flow.
